CROSS REFERENCE.

SUBJECT:-

On 7.2.40 a list of the DEMUTH COMMITTEE was received through B.2. Members of the Propaganda Section included:-

Dr. H. von RAUSCHENPLAT. Teacher of Economics, Farming. Formerly at a People's College near Cassel. Was economic Editor of a Berlin Socialist Daily.

Original in.....S.F.75/Germany/32.V.2.36b..dated...7.2.40

S. Form 81.
